description.value: A farm stand and café on Highway 97 North selling Okanagan-grown fruits, vegetables, and ice cream, situated just off the Okanagan Rail Trail. The operation grows its own crops and hosts seasonal community events such as a Cherry Pickup Party Market each summer. With over 1,200 Facebook followers and a 94% recommendation rate from reviews, it is a well-regarded local stop for fresh produce in the North Kelowna area.
